newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's king delays U.S. visit, returns home.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king delays U.S. visit, returns home.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein cut short a visit to Spain on Thursday and put off a trip to Washington to return home after one of his soldiers killed seven Israeli schoolgirls on Jordanian soil, an aide said.
"His Majesty has decided to delay his visit to the United States and go back to Amman immediately," the king's military attache Brigadier-General Ali Shukri told Israel Radio.
The king was in Spain on his way to Washington for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton on troubled Arab-Israeli peace moves.
The king called Israeli President Ezer Weizman to express shock and anger at the killings, Shukri told the radio.

"His Majesty expressed his feelings of shock, pain and anger at the murder committed earlier this morning on Jordanian territory which resulted in the death or injury of a number of innocent and unarmed Israeli guests to Jordan, most of whom were children students," he said.
"He considers these treacherous bullets to have been directed against him and his sons and daughters in his own home," the aide said.
